Name: Add Berry Seasons to Calendar
Author: inmognito
Description:
Updated backgrounds for the Billboard , adding icons for seasonal events not currently recorded on the calendar:

[list]
[*]15 Spring to 18 Spring: Salmonberry season
[*]12 Summer to 14 Summer: Extra beach forage
[*]8 Fall to 11 Fall: Blackberry season
[/list]
This is my first mod, and about as basic as it's possible for a mod to get.  It should be compatible with most mods, unless they also replace the billboard background.

[b]Now won't conflict with other calendar mods and will support other languages.[/b]

Manifest.Name: Add Berry Seasons to Calendar
Manifest.Description: Adds berry icons to the calendar for salmonberry and blackberry harvesting days, and shell icons for the summer
